archetypes.name: fd-contract
archetypes.rationale: The port relies on fd 1/2/3 capture and quiet routing semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the fd isolation helper and every caller that captures stage or failure-report output. Verify stdout, stderr, and fd-3 contract rows are restored after in-process calls and still land in the historical artifact paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: final-summary
archetypes.rationale: The final-summary background marker and sentinel ordering are hook-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on step_final_summary_core and the launcher mapping. Check pause-before-marker behavior, marker cleanup on failure, final-summary marker emission through quiet routing, sidecar handoff, and completion sentinel ordering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retired-callers
archetypes.rationale: Deleted shell helpers require complete caller retargeting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search for real runtime callers of the retired shell paths. Confirm launcher basename mappings are intentional, direct file path references were removed, and docs/tests distinguish historical audit labels from executable paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
